family: Fair five-control Boolean parent with exactly two pivotal query edges. Local selected-coordinate B only. Ternary projected three-bit core h=(a(0,z)+a(1,z))/2 after query-independent normalizations, h(0)=1.
symmetry: Linear map of unqueried coordinates maps the two changed vertices to 0 and e_1; a common remaining-coordinate character makes both child values +1. These preserve selected B and selected influence only; no other physical influence or boundary is transferred.
arithmetic: Direct integer Walsh sums; B<=1/2 by integer product comparisons, including t=0 with 0^0=1. No floating point.
